topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I scarce can wrap my mind around such happenings, what with the lord's mills and the church's doings being the most peculiar things to see hereabouts. They say the iron horse, that contraption of the city folk, was taken away from under a man's very Nose! It seems the land outside our humble vale is full of odd customs and harsh ways. I heard tell from a traveler that some folks pay good coin just to keep their iron beasts parked. The world be a strange place, far from the quiet rows of barley and the gentle slopes of our fields. I pray the saints be kind and that the man finds his beast again, soon as can be. Mayhaps there's no peace for the troubled soul, what with the demands of the beasts they wield.
